Normal.recommendation: Encourage lifestyle modification and annual screening.

Stage 1.recommendation: Calculate 10-yr ASCVD risk; if >=10% initiate monotherapy (ACEi, ARB, CCB, or thiazide).

Stage 2.recommendation: Initiate 2 first-line agents of different classes. Monthly follow-up until controlled.

Hypertensive Crisis.recommendation: Evaluate for target organ damage. Emergency Department admission if symptomatic.

DIABETES_ADA_2024.title: ADA Standards of Medical Care in Diabetes
DIABETES_ADA_2024.ascvdHeartFailurePriority: Add SGLT2i or GLP-1 RA with proven CVD benefit.

SEPSIS_SURVIVING_2024.title: Surviving Sepsis Campaign 1-Hour Bundle
bundleSteps: 1. Measure blood lactate level. Remeasure if initial lactate > 2 mmol/L.
2. Obtain blood cultures prior to administration of antibiotics.
4. Rapidly administer 30 mL/kg crystalloid for hypotension or lactate >= 4 mmol/L.
5. Apply vasopressors (Norepinephrine first line) if hypotensive during or after fluid resuscitation to maintain MAP >= 65 mm Hg.
